verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos into a charged Empower or a Counter Strike stun; you win if you land E first and convert it into a Vessel or Tentacle-backed burst before Jax's build catches up.

brief.thesis: Test of Spirit is a spell, not a basic attack, so it — and everything it echoes, including Tentacle swings — goes through Jax's Counter Strike stance untouched, while a spirit target that dies or runs too far instantly becomes a Vessel that spawns more Tentacles. That single interaction is the whole 54.2% win rate over 854 games: Illaoi has a spell-and-sustain package Jax's only defensive cooldown can't answer, and her Passive rewards fighting near jungle walls where Jax gets nothing back.

theirWindow.what: He'll leap in with Q (Leap Strike) or empower an auto for bonus damage to everyone nearby — don't stand still to trade autos here; back off a step or let a Tentacle eat it instead of you.

yourWindow.what: Follow immediately with W (Harsh Lesson) to leap in and pull nearby Tentacles onto him, then Q (Tentacle Smash) — all of it echoes through the spirit link onto Jax for a burst window Counter Strike can't fully dodge.

powerCurve.note: No E yet; Empowered autos trade hard
E online, Vessel threat forces bad fights
R adds tentacles; still ahead on kill threat
Cleaver/Iceborn spikes close Jax's damage gap

start.why: Highest-win, highest-pick start here (57.4% over 570 games) — the extra AD tunes your auto-into-E-into-tentacle trade for max damage over Doran's Helm.

boots.why: Best-performing boots (57% over 635 games) and correct into a mostly auto-attack threat — Jax's Empower and his no-cooldown R both scale off basic attacks, so flat armor blunts more of his DPS than tenacity would.

core.why: Armor shred stacks off your Q, W, and tentacle procs, keeping Jax's effective HP down even as he buys resistances.
Its proc adds a slow onto Harsh Lesson so Jax can't just walk out of Tentacle range after you've spirit-linked him.
Bonus health and the damage-reduction shield cover the exact burst window his Empowered attack plus Counter Strike stun is built to punish.

situational.when: if you need more raw sustain from Tentacle healing against a bruiser-heavy enemy team
if you're getting bursted down before your Tentacle healing has time to tick back
if you're already snowballing off early solo kills and want to close the game fast instead of scaling to a five-item fight

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the same extended, Tentacle-backed trades you're already forcing, giving you sustain Jax's single stun window can't offset.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is the most-picked line (54.1% WR, 56.2% pick) and keeps your wave/TP advantage in a lane you're already favored to push; Flash + Exhaust carries the single highest win rate here (55.7%) and directly answers Jax's all-in — his Empowered attack, Counter Strike stun, and attack-speed R — if he tries to flatten you before your Vessel pressure lands.

playing.title: Fight near jungle walls
playing.detail: Your Passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain, and Illaoi or any Vessel triggers them — pull trades toward top-side walls so every E and W lands with extra Tentacle damage and healing.

playing.title: Open trades with E first
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (16-12s cooldown) tethers a spirit that echoes a percentage of damage back onto Jax — land it before he leaps in with Q so any damage you deal, tentacles included, doubles onto him.

playing.title: Ignore autos into his E
playing.detail: When Jax pops Counter Strike mid-engage he dodges all incoming basic attacks — hold your right-clicks and hit him with E and W instead, since neither is a basic attack, then resume autos once his stance ends and he stuns.

playing.title: Threaten Vessel kills, not just damage
playing.detail: If Test of Spirit's target dies or gets too far from their spirit, they become a Vessel that spawns its own Tentacles — use this as your solo-kill lever whenever Jax overextends past level 3.

playing.title: Respect Empower windows
playing.detail: Jax's W (cooldown 7-3s) buffs his next attack or Leap Strike with bonus AoE damage — if you see it light up, don't feed it your body; bait it onto a Tentacle instead.

playing.title: R is a finisher, not an opener
playing.detail: Leap of Faith (cd 120-70s) only spawns Tentacles for champions it directly hits, so save it to close a fight you're already winning off E/W damage — Jax's own R has no cooldown and only gets stronger the longer the fight runs.

playing.title: Push levels 3-5 before his spikes
playing.detail: Your kill and lane advantage front-load before items — use E-into-Vessel pressure to shove and threaten solo kills in this window, banking gold before Black Cleaver/Iceborn close the gap.

brief.patchCaveat: Item order, rune page, and summoner spells are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the timing and mechanical reasoning behind them is my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: When Jax uses (E) while closing in, use [E] in response and deal damage through basic attacks and [W] during the duration of (E). You can also use [E] first to start off the engagement. Jax is an easy matchup after reaching level 3.
